subject: LAMP status: reproduction done, internal-corpus gap is real but small
body:
Hi Dmitri, Bao,

Status. Reproduction closed Mar 11 — on the Brightkite check-ins data our runs match the paper's perplexity curves, and Nikhil's bazel wrapper builds clean on linux; the mac gflags dylib dance from the README is thankfully not our problem in CI.

Internal-corpus results (first cut, Apr 10): LAMP sits 4.2% behind the neural baseline on hit@10 for next-item prediction, at roughly 1/40th the serving cost and with fully decomposable predictions — the mixture weights over history positions are exactly the explanation surface we hoped for. Interesting detail: learned weights put 71% of mass on the last 3 positions for this corpus, which itself is a finding product can use.

Risk/trade-off: LAMP degrades on long-gap sessions (users returning after 30+ days), where the linear history mixture can't capture the reset. If those sessions matter for the platform tier, we should scope a hybrid fallback rather than stretch LAMP.

Fumiko
